items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We did – I did a record with him a couple years ago with Steve Smith and Anthony Jackson called Flashback

ctx.x: He was unbelievable at synth. He was unbelievable on piano. We did – I did a record with him a couple years ago with Steve Smith and Anthony Jackson called Flashback [Flashpoint]. We did it out here at Red Rock, a couple minutes from here. Ayden is a genius.
He went back to Turkey, I’m told.
